_comment: Live GitHub Pages project sites. Each is published from its own repo and mounted under this domain at /<repo>/ — they are NOT part of this build's output. Authoritative list, used twice by scripts/prerender-meta.mjs: (1) legacy-redirect keys are checked against it, so a redirect stub can never be written over a working demo; (2) each path is emitted into sitemap.xml, since nothing in this build links to them at crawl time (the /work/ 'Live piece' links only exist after the SPA hydrates).
_lastmodNote: No <lastmod> is emitted: these deploy from separate repos on their own schedule, so this build cannot know when they last changed. lastmod is optional in the sitemap protocol, and a stale value is worse than none.
